mechanism: Clobazam as a benzodiazepine may induce hepatic metabolism and potentially affect vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor synthesis, while vitamin K may theoretically affect clobazam metabolism through hepatic enzyme pathways.
action: Monitor coagulation parameters (INR/PT) in patients on concurrent warfarin or anticoagulants; counsel on consistent vitamin K intake to maintain stable anticoagulant effects; assess for changes in seizure control or sedation.
